shapeSummary: Rectangular encoder PCB, 22.5 mm (X) by 18.5 mm (Y) by 1.6 mm thick (Z). Y runs from 0 to 18.5 and the board is centered in X and Z. It has a 4 mm through hole for the motor shaft and a row of six 1 mm pad holes at 2.54 mm pitch near the +Y header edge. The magnetic disc, header pins, and corner slots are not modeled.
warnings: Dimensions are estimated from the description and bounds; none are verified.
The board is modeled as a plain rectangle. The real outline has a notched or rounded shape.
The corner solder slots are visible but omitted because their size and position are uncertain.
The magnetic disc and the male and female header pins are separate parts and are excluded.
The 4 mm center hole size and position are visual estimates.
The 1 mm pad hole diameter and positions are assumed.
Hole positions were shifted by +9.25 mm in Y to put the board bottom at Y=0. The board thickness runs along Z, as in the given bounds.
